Release notes for `bgms` and for this documentation site, newest first. The
package's complete change log, including breaking changes and bug fixes, is
[NEWS.md](https://github.com/Bayesian-Graphical-Modelling-Lab/bgms/blob/main/NEWS.md)
in the package repository.

## 2026-07-30: bgms 0.2.0.0 on CRAN

The headline addition is
[`prior_sensitivity_check()`](reference/prior-sensitivity.qmd). It recovers
each edge's inclusion Bayes factor as a continuous curve across the
interaction slab scale, anchored at a handful of fixed-scale refits and filled
in between them by importance reweighting, and then tells you which edge
verdicts actually depend on your prior choice. Verdicts that only wobble
between reruns of the same prior are reported as wobble rather than as prior
sensitivity, so you can separate a real dependence on the slab scale from
Monte Carlo noise.

This release also brings Gaussian and mixed graphical models to
[`bgm()`](reference/bgm.qmd) through `variable_type = "continuous"` and
per-variable type vectors, Rao-Blackwellized edge inclusion probabilities as
the default estimator in
[`extract_posterior_inclusion_probabilities()`](reference/extractors.qmd#extract_posterior_inclusion_probabilities),
missing-data imputation during sampling, and a rewritten C++ backend with
shared NUTS infrastructure across model types.

## 2026-07-30: Documentation site launched

This site replaces the reference-only pages that used to live at this address.
It adds a [User's Guide](guide/index.qmd) that explains the modelling and prior
choices behind a fit, a [Reference](reference/index.qmd) grouped by topic
rather than by help file, and a [Manual](manual/index.qmd) that documents the
C++ internals for contributors.

Links to the old pages redirect here, so existing bookmarks and citations keep
working.
